govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FBISocietyofFor: This item — Hoover’s Loyal Legion: Society of Former FBI Agents, creator unknown — is a file on the ex-agents’ group. The loyalists defended Hoover’s legacy. The file belongs to the political archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
the-net: Rex Beach, the bestselling author of The Spoilers, spins a novel of intrigue and high-stakes scheming. His hero is drawn into a web of plotters where money, power, and a woman's honor hang in the balance. Beach's muscular, fast-moving style made him one of America's most popular storytellers, and this tale delivers the adventure his readers expected.
the-little-nugget: P. G. Wodehouse's early comic novel centers on Ogden Ford — the Little Nugget — a monstrously spoiled child heir whom various parties plot to kidnap. Enter Sam Fisher, tutor and reluctant schemer, in a tangle of abductions and romance. The master's light touch is already evident in this fast, funny romp.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbey-of-frig: A 1913 entry on Frigolet, the Provençal abbey among the pines. Mistral's wind sings through its cloister. Francis Martin Geudens tells its tale. Southern France in monastic dress. Alphonse Daudet set his tales among its hills. Pilgrims climb its hill for the August pardon.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adrien-baille: A 1913 entry on Adrien Baillet — the French scholar of saints' lives. Joseph Sollier notes his critical temper. His Vies des saints sifted legend from fact. Jansen's shadow touched his work. Learning with an edge of rigor. His Descartes biography remains a classic.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-amulet: A 1913 entry on the amulet — the charm against evil. Maurice Hassett treats its history. The Church blessed medals instead. Superstition dressed as devotion. A folk custom, judged by faith. Its use lingers in the villages. Its medals replaced the pagan charms.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antonio-comel: A 1913 entry on Antonio Comellas — a Spanish philosopher of note. R. Bolos records his works. The entry preserves his modest fame. His pen served the Catholic schools. A thinker of the Peninsula. His lectures drew the Barcelona students. His system opposed the Krausist tide.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-augustin-magl: This 1913 reference article on Augustin Blanchet — the Bishop of Walla Walla. Louis Reilly tells his pioneer rule. He built the northwestern Church. The frontier tested his zeal. A bishop of the far missions. His see became the Seattle archdiocese. His missions dotted the Pacific Northwest.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-benedict-jose: This 1913 reference article on Benedict Flaget — the first Bishop of Bardstown. Camillus Maes honors his pioneer rule. He built the Kentucky Church. The frontier tested his zeal. The father of the western hierarchy. His cathedral crowns the Bardstown hill.
